notes.title: Demo Update - 0.9.4 - August 18, 2024
notes.content: Order Automatica has been selected to be a part of the Seattle Indies Expo IRL event. I've done some updates in preparation. This demo build is the build I'll be showing at the event. Enjoy!

notes.title: Demo Update - March 16, 2024 - Version 0.9.1
notes.content:
Just like the headline says, there's a new demo!

It's a huge update from the previous demo, most notably with a big art update, but also lots of balancing changes and bugfixes.

Thanks for playing : )

notes.title: 0.7.6 Update For Playtest
notes.content:
A bunch of updates to the playtest version of the game, which is open to anyone who signs up:

📙 Small story revisions and sketches for stories 1-1 through 1-3

👁️ New rank unlocked message and demo specific % complete

📖 Adds a wiki page for indulgences

🪧Adds different messages for demo version

🐛 No longer allows dying units to be included in combining into levelled unit

🐛 Fixes bug with unmovable units on bottom row after they have been deselected

🐛 Fixes bug where you can move/sell a unit that is getting killed by Statim Mortem in the prep phase

🥰 New enemy teams for 1-2 and 1-3 (and these ranks now have multiple enemy teams each)

💩 Reintroduced Infected Heretic unit

🦆 Text and callout for Silent Executioner's useless distillation

🥲 Altar beast now only buffs "newest" adjacent summons

🥲 Fixes some wiki text about preparation and adds info in wiki about new distillation system

💩 Makes in-store attainment and wiki stuff easier to close/navigate - fixes help link for distillation

🔥🔥 First pass at new distillation behavior - only triggers N times per battle

notes.title: Development Update! - February 2023
notes.content:
Hi all!

I just wanted to take a second to share with you what's going on in development.

First of all, we got some really amazing capsule art from the artist Steven Hancher. Not only does this help us get attention for the game, but the process really helped us think about the vibe and story of the game. Check it out:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756041/5c113b0ea9864b4dea64c441703027f4aed11edd.png[/img]

Secondly, we've been doing a big overhaul to the in-game visuals, which is being done by Kartik Kini from Finite Reflection studios. We're really excited about it: 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756041/0562c462297816d82f5053d5d26c2afd2fb7f5ae.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756041/36d1c06e425efeaf0842b7a2b28b0ff361ec63ff.png[/img]

We've also been moving along with the overall shape of the game, which you can get a teeeny peek at here:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42756041/1edb95c1f32660e17c33b10e6249e9356ea12289.png[/img]

Anyway, that's all for now!

Compulsion awaits.

Best,
Mickey
